IaC template: the output bucket name/reference passed to the ThumbnailerFunction environment
answer.explanation: Between 02:02 and 02:15 UTC the ThumbnailerFunction logged about 490 identical '[ERROR] NoSuchBucket' failures on S3 PutObject to OUTPUT_BUCKET (handler.py line 43), and the errors recur from about 00:21 UTC. The UploaderFunction, CompressionFunction and CrudApiFunction show only normal REPORT/START/END lines with no errors. NoSuchBucket is a bucket-existence failure, not an AccessDenied, so the IAM execution role is not the cause. The handler code itself is unchanged in its behaviour, so the most likely fault is the OUTPUT_BUCKET value in the live configuration pointing at a bucket that does not exist. The bucket name is not visible in the logs, so I could not confirm the exact value, and the IaC template is a secondary candidate. No CloudWatch alarms are active.
